title: (optional) Entering time-stamped notes in the Udemy video player

cues.en: Instructor: If you are already an experienced Udemy student, then you can probably skip this video.
cues.zh: 如果你已經是有經驗的 Udemy 學生，大概可以跳過這部影片。

cues.en: I just wanna make a quick video to introduce you to this Notes option, which used to be the Bookmarks option, but now, they improved it a bit,
cues.zh: 我只是想簡短介紹這個「備註」選項，以前叫做「書籤」，現在他們做了一些改進，

cues.en: just so you get an idea of what it's gonna be used for.
cues.zh: 讓你了解它的用途。

cues.en: So if you look at the timeline, you can actually see these gray buttons here, and you can see that, you know, a bunch of people wrote a note here, so, I don't know.
cues.zh: 看時間軸，可以看到這些灰色按鈕，也能看出有一群人在這裡寫了備註。

cues.en: You can't actually see other people's notes, but you can see where other people have written a note.
cues.zh: 實際上看不到其他人的備註內容，但能看到他們在哪裡寫了備註。

cues.en: So that tells you that 19 people have thought that this is a particularly important section.
cues.zh: 這就告訴你，有 19 個人認為這是特別重要的段落。

cues.en: Now, you can create your own notes.
cues.zh: 你也可以建立自己的備註。

cues.en: As you're going through, you can either click on this button here, Add note, or you can just press the plus sign on your keyboard,
cues.zh: 觀看時，可以點這裡的「新增備註」，或直接按鍵盤上的加號，

cues.en: that's a keyboard shortcut.
cues.zh: 那是快捷鍵。

cues.en: And now, here, you can add detailed notes, you know, "This is important because of x, y, z."
cues.zh: 接著能在這裡加入詳細備註，例如「這很重要，因為 x、y、z」。

cues.en: And, you know, there's some formatting, I don't know, if you really wanna get into all this formatting business.
cues.zh: 如果真的想仔細設定，也有一些格式選項。

cues.en: But it's there if you want to.
cues.zh: 想用的話，功能都在這裡。

cues.en: This would be the code formatting option if you wanna include a little bit of code and make it look nice.
cues.zh: 如果想加入一點程式碼並漂亮排版，這就是程式碼格式選項。

cues.en: You can say, maybe I'll make for i=1:10, disp(i).
cues.zh: 例如可以寫 for i=1:10，disp(i)。

cues.en: You know, this is not particularly important code, but just to illustrate how this code formatting tool works.
cues.zh: 這不是特別重要的程式碼，只是示範格式工具如何運作。

cues.en: And then, you click Save note.
cues.zh: 接著點「儲存備註」。

cues.en: And now this note is saved, so we can see it turns yellow for you.
cues.zh: 現在備註儲存好了，可以看到它對你顯示為黃色。

cues.en: Now, this is only your note, no one else can see this note that you wrote, not even me as the instructor.
cues.zh: 這只是你自己的備註，沒有其他人看得到你寫的內容，連我這個講師也看不到。

cues.en: I cannot see this note, it's just for you.
cues.zh: 我無法看到，只有你自己能看。

cues.en: So that's your note.
cues.zh: 這就是你的備註。

cues.en: And then you can go down here, you click on, you know, here's the Q&A, and here's the Notes.
cues.zh: 接著可以往下，這裡是「問與答」，這裡是「備註」。

cues.en: So then, you see your different notes, and then you can edit them if you want.
cues.zh: 你會看到自己的不同備註，需要時可以編輯。

cues.en: Of course, you can delete them as well if you no longer find that note particularly relevant.
cues.zh: 當然，如果覺得某則備註已經不太相關，也能刪除。
